sections: 8.3-8.5 explicit page geometry and content isolation

decisions: Keep event views immutable and all user callbacks before successful return/atomic publication
Specify source-record/template/layout/final-page/write-prepared order rather than announce an already committed destination
Use one mandatory context through all SDK-owned binding/layout/model/provider/write work and attach it during model mutation
Reject caught reentrant/cross-thread mutations through permanent diagnostics; expire contexts and require closed workers/scopes before publication
Keep explicit culture/field/font/provider/resource choices and reference-identity cycle checks separate from arbitrary callback behavior
Treat opaque synchronous/uncooperative extensions as an unqualified host-isolation profile; do not claim hard termination for caller code
